lessons.title: 2. Multi-way Branching with `elif`
lessons.description: When you have more than two branches, use `elif`. Implement `temperature_status(temp)` returning "Cold" (< 15), "Warm" (15..28), or "Hot" (> 28).

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — 4.1. if Statements — Conditional Control

options: `if temp < 15` should be `if temp <= 15`, so 15 counts as Cold
`elif temp < 28` should be `elif temp <= 28`, so 28 counts as Warm
nothing is wrong - `Hot` is correct for 28 because it is the last branch
exercises.correct_answer: `elif temp < 28` should be `elif temp <= 28`, so 28 counts as Warm
exercises.explanation: Only the upper boundary is off: 28 fails both `< 15` and `< 28`, so it falls through to Hot. The lower boundary already treats 15 as Warm, which is what the lesson asks for.

lessons.title: 3. Meltdown Mitigation (Concept Challenge)
lessons.description:
Control a nuclear reactor with multi-condition if/elif/else logic.

1. is_criticality_balanced(temperature, neutrons_emitted): return True when the reactor is balanced, i.e. temperature is below 800 AND neutrons_emitted is above 500.
2. reactor_efficiency(voltage, current, theoretical_max_power): compute the percentage (voltage * current / theoretical_max_power) * 100 and return its band: green for >= 80, orange for >= 60, red for >= 30, and black below 30.
3. fail_safe(temperature, neutrons_produced_per_second, threshold): compare temperature * neutrons_produced_per_second with the threshold and return LOW below 90% of the threshold, NORMAL from 90% up to and including 110%, and DANGER above 110%.
learning_objectives: Use if, elif, and else statements to control execution flow
Implement guard conditions and multi-clause boolean checks

options: The 80 test matches first, so the 90 branch is never reached
Python compares the strings "A" and "B", not the numbers
exercises.correct_answer: The 80 test matches first, so the 90 branch is never reached
exercises.explanation: `if`/`elif` stops at the first true test, so the narrowest threshold must be checked first (90 before 80).
